content.title: The Official Lower Greenville St Patrick's Block Party
content.text: MUSIC 〰️ DRINKS 〰️ FOOD 〰️ 〰️ BEER TENTS 〰️ LIVE DJS 〰️ 8 PARTICIPATING BARS & RESTAURANTS 〰️ AGES 21+ ONLY 〰️ 7 GATE ENTRANCES 〰️ Gate Admission Cash Only 〰️ ATMs at gates and throughout 〰️ RAIN OR SHINE 〰️ MUSIC 〰️ DRINKS 〰️ FOOD 〰️ PARTY 〰️ BEER TENTS 〰️ LIVE DJS 〰️ 8 PARTICIPATING BARS & RESTAURANTS 〰️ AGES 21+ ONLY 〰️ 7 GATE ENTRANCES 〰️ Gate Admission Cash Only 〰️ ATMs at gates and throughout 〰️ RAIN OR SHINE 〰️ THE OFFICIAL LOWER GREENVILLE SAINT pATRICK’S BLOCK PARTY Dallas’ Most Iconic St. Patrick’s Celebration ReturnsSaT march 14 20269 am - 6 pmbars stay open until 2 am Dallas’s Biggest St. Patrick’s Day CelebrationBrought to you by the Vanderbilt to Vickery Association, the Lower Greenville St. Patrick’s Day Block Party in Dallas is one of the city’s most anticipated St Patrick’s Day events, turning Lower Greenville Avenue into a massive 21+ street celebration. Each year, Greenville Ave fills with thousands of guests enjoying outdoor beer tents, live DJs across multiple music stages, and a lineup of popular Lower Greenville bars and restaurants. With the street closed to traffic, attendees can move freely between venues, experience exclusive drink specials, and take part in one of the most energetic St Patrick’s Day parties in Dallas.How to attend$20 cash AT ADMISSION GATE | 21+ Arrive at Lower Greenville between Vanderbilt and Vickery on Saturday, March 14, from 9 AM to 6 PM, and enter through any official admission gate. Participating bars and restaurants remain open until 2 AM.Gate entry is $20 per person (cash only). There are multiple entry gates. All guests receive an event wristband upon admission. Once inside, enjoy access to participating venues, street beer tents, music stages, and event specials.Valid government-issued ID required. This is a 21+ only event.
